name: Statistician
responsibilities: Decide which statistical method actually fits the question and the data before running anything
Design experiments, sampling plans, and analytical methods that hold up to scrutiny
Report results with the right charts, tables, and caveats so non-statisticians don't over-read them
skills: Choosing and applying the right statistical method for the research question, not just the familiar one
Cleaning, weighting, and validating raw data before it ever reaches a model
Designing experiments and sampling techniques that produce data you can trust
Communicating statistical findings clearly to clients, peers, or students through graphs and plain language
rawSkillPool: Business intelligence and data analysis software
Evaluating validity, applicability, and accuracy of methods
Identifying relationships and trends in data
Data base user interface and query software
Interpreting statistical results for non-technical audiences
Adapting methods across fields (economics, biology, engineering)
Reporting results with charts, bullets, and graphs

evidence.title: Statisticians (SOC 15-2041.00), O*NET 29.1 database
evidence.quote: Develop or apply mathematical or statistical theory and methods to collect, organize, interpret, and summarize numerical data to provide usable information.

evidence.title: Statisticians: Tasks, O*NET 29.1 database
evidence.quote: Evaluate the statistical methods and procedures used to obtain data to ensure validity, applicability, efficiency, and accuracy. Prepare data for processing by organizing information, checking for inaccuracies, and adjusting and weighting the raw data. Develop and test experimental designs, sampling techniques, and analytical methods.
